subject: PrimeVault onboarding: PO tokenization & spend-slice reconciliation
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@primevault.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeVault Finance <finance@primevault.io>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: PrimeVault - initial PO request and SKU list

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for walking us through onboarding last week. Attached is our completed vendor request form (PV_PO_request_form_v2.pdf) and an initial SKU mapping for the services we'll be consuming (PrimeVault_SKU_mapping.xlsx).

High-level ask: we need a single top-level PO for the initial term (12 months) with three line items representing: ingestion credits, retention tier, and priority support. Our procurement team has requested a spend cap of $120,000 for the first 90 days to align with budget phasing. If you need any alternate line-item breakdowns to match your ledger, we can adapt.

Please confirm the expected PO number pattern and any fields we must populate on our side before you issue.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Operations, PrimeVault
Elena Ruiz | PrimeVault
Phone: +1-415-555-0198

Attachments: PV_PO_request_form_v2.pdf, PrimeVault_SKU_mapping.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@primevault.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: PrimeVault - initial PO request and SKU list

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the docs, this is a good start. A few quick clarifications before I route to Finance for a PO number:

- We prefer three distinct ledger line items. Your spreadsheet maps well, but we need each SKU to include the internal product code (e.g., RV-INGEST-XX). I’ve flagged the rows in the attached spreadsheet and added suggested Redwood product codes.
- Spend cap: Finance typically approves a 90-day provisional cap. $120k looks reasonable but they'll probably split it as $70k (ingestion), $35k (retention), $15k (support). If PrimeVault wants a different split, please confirm.
- Billing cadence: Monthly in arrears; please confirm the email for invoice reception (billing@primevault.io ok?).

I’m attaching an annotated copy of your SKU sheet (see inline comments). Once you confirm the split and invoice email, I’ll open the PO request ticket and request provisional PO number PV-12345-PENDING.

Thanks — looping in Marcus for the PO generation and Vanessa for the legal/procurement checklist.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PrimeVault_SKU_mapping.xlsx (annotated)

From: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@primevault.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@primevault.io>
Date: 2026-12-11T08:34:00Z
Subject: Re: PrimeVault - initial PO request and SKU list

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick review. Confirming the split you suggested is acceptable to PrimeVault: 70/35/15. Invoice contact should be billing@primevault.io (same domain).

Two small asks: can you add a short clause on the PO that clarifies Firebase-style usage credits are metered per ingestion event (our SKU doc shows the metric). Also, will the provisional PO number change once fully approved by Finance? We need a stable identifier to include on our internal vendor onboarding checklist.

If that all works, I can sign and return via DocuSign.

Regards,
Carlos Mendes
Finance Operations, PrimeVault

Kimberly / Vanessa —

I opened ticket PR-2026-1118 in our procurement tracker and attached the reviewed forms. Finance has provisionally reserved PO PV-12345-PENDING; final PO number will be PV-12345 once the spend cap and line items are finalized and legal confirms the minimal clause language.

Action items:
- Vanessa: can you confirm the short usage-metering sentence is acceptable to Legal/Contracts? We should avoid adding T&Cs that change net payment terms.
- Elena/Carlos: please sign the DocuSign I’m about to send (link embedded in the ticket) so Finance can push to final approval.

Short internal note: I split the spend into 70/35/15 in the PR line items to match the request. The SKU tokens were normalized to Redwood codes (RV-INGEST-001, RV-RET-STD-01, RV-SUPPORT-PRIO).

Marcus
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Related links: https://procure.redwood.com/PR-2026-1118

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Legal has reviewed the short usage-metering sentence and we are OK with the proposed language as long as the invoice line references the SKU token we agreed on. I have attached the signed PO (PV_PO_12345_signed.pdf) and completed the procurement checklist.

Finals:
- Final PO number: PV-12345
- Spend cap (first 90 days): $120,000 (split 70/35/15)
- Invoice contact: billing@primevault.io
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/abcdef123456
